P0217.hazard: Engine thermal runaway leading to fire or mechanical failure at any speed
P0217.safety_goal: SG-01: Detect engine overheat within 500ms and alert driver; prevent thermal runaway by continuous monitoring

P0562.hazard: Loss of vehicle electrical power causing failure of safety-critical systems while driving
P0562.safety_goal: SG-02: Warn driver of low battery voltage before complete power loss; monitor continuously while system is active

P0219.hazard: Loss of vehicle control at excessive speed, increasing collision risk and severity
P0219.safety_goal: SG-03: Alert driver immediately when speed exceeds profile-configured limit; log all overspeed events

C0077.hazard: Tire blowout or loss of vehicle stability resulting in rollover or uncontrolled lane departure
C0077.safety_goal: SG-04: Detect and alert low tire pressure in real time; trigger warning at or below 25 PSI threshold

B1026.hazard: Occupant ejection or injury due to open door while vehicle is in motion above 10 km/h
B1026.safety_goal: SG-05: Immediately raise CRITICAL alert if any door is detected open while vehicle speed exceeds 10 km/h

B0075.hazard: Severe occupant injury or fatality in a collision due to unrestrained occupant
B0075.safety_goal: SG-06: Continuously alert driver when seatbelt is unfastened while vehicle speed exceeds 10 km/h
